excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: Great work! Though, we're still refining this PR, but nothing substantial is expected

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
We have the following statement in the current spec:
> Client software **MUST** return `-32002: Invalid terminal block` error if the most recent PoW block in the chain of a payload ancestors, that is a PoW block with the highest `blockNumber`, doesn't satisfy terminal block conditions according to the EIP-3675

What do people think about returning an error in this case? Should it be a separate status e.g. `INVALID_TERMINAL_BLOCK` instead of an error?

excerpts.author: ryanleeschneider
excerpts.content: Is your `master` branch the primary branch we should be using for geth Kintsugi testing?  I've been running off your `merge-kintsugi` branch previously.

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
Heads up -- the engine API semantics changs are complete and ready for final review before a release cut this Friday.
These are the previously discussed changes on the last two calls. Shouldn't be any big surprises. But please review!
* https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/165 (engine api semantics)
* https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/167 (engine api auth -- to be merged shortly)

Thanks <@!360491619402776577> for implementing the updated semantics! I think he'll release some sanity vectors soon
